_readme: UI text for DGLAB-NX, one file per language. The file name and the "language" field must match; every key in nro/include/dglab/ui/strings.h has to be here, a missing one falls back to another loaded language; keys starting with "_" are ignored (docs/nro-ui.md).
name: English

strings.desc_socket: Start the WebSocket server and scan the QR code with the DG-LAB 3.0 App to connect to the Switch.
strings.desc_motion: Drive the waveform with the Joy-Cons: stronger swings produce larger waveform values and denser pulses on the corresponding channel. Left Joy-Con is channel A, right is B. Requires a connection to the app or a Coyote device.
strings.desc_touch: Drive the waveform by touching the screen: the left half is channel A and the right half is channel B. Higher up means a larger waveform value, further right inside each half means denser pulses. Lift your finger and the output follows the release curve. Requires a connection to the app or a Coyote device.
strings.desc_about: About the project and app settings.
strings.about_line1: Unofficial DG-LAB controller for Nintendo Switch Atmosphère CFW.
strings.about_line2: The Sysmodule manages Bluetooth connections, the WebSocket server and the protocol; this NRO communicates with it over IPC.
strings.touch_docked: Touch input is unavailable while docked. Undock the console.
strings.advanced_save_failed: Error: could not save parameters. They still apply for this session.
strings.desc_deadzone_enter: How much movement is needed before anything is output. Raise it if a hand that merely holds a Joy-Con still produces output.
strings.desc_deadzone_exit: How far the movement has to fall before the mode counts as still again. It sits below the enter value so the level does not flicker at the edge.
strings.desc_gyro_range: The rotation speed that counts as full output. Smaller means a gentler movement already reaches the top.
strings.desc_accel_range: The acceleration change that counts as full output: this is the term that reacts to a sudden jerk rather than to steady movement.
strings.desc_weight: How much this term contributes. Set one to 0 to find out what the other one is responsible for.
strings.desc_attack: How quickly the output follows a movement. Too short and every reading shows up as a spike.
strings.desc_release: How long the output takes to fall back to silence after the movement stops.
strings.desc_idle_stop: How long the controller has to stay still before uploading stops completely. The release still finishes first.
strings.desc_frequency_fast: The pulse interval at full intensity. Smaller is denser: more pulses per second at the same amplitude means more current, so it changes both intensity and feel. The device minimum is 10ms.
strings.desc_frequency_still: The pulse interval while still. This is what the output starts from as a movement fades out.
strings.desc_density_fixed: Variable lets the pulse interval follow the mode: the motion mode follows the swing, the touch mode follows how far right the finger is. Fixed holds the interval at the value below, so only the waveform value moves.
strings.desc_frequency_fixed: The pulse interval used while the density is fixed. Smaller is denser: more pulses per second at the same amplitude is also more current. The device floor is 10ms.
strings.desc_strength_max: The waveform value at full intensity. The device multiplies it by the channel strength.
strings.desc_channel_limit: How strong this channel may ever get. The device enforces it, and it is not the strength itself: the strength is the number the pages dial, the limit is the ceiling it cannot pass. At 0 the channel cannot pulse at all, whatever the strength says.
strings.qr_hint: Scan QR Code with DG-LAB 3.0 App
strings.qr_not_running: The WebSocket server is not running. Press A to start it (it stops automatically 55 s after the client leaves).
strings.qr_too_long: The address is too long to fit in a QR code.
strings.sleep_warning: Do not sleep while the server runs
strings.sleep_warning_auto_off: Auto sleep is off; sleeping by hand still hangs the console
strings.desc_ble: The Switch drives a Coyote V3 device directly over Bluetooth. Set the device's MAC address first. Currently only open-loop control is supported (commands are sent in one direction).
strings.menu_ble_running: A Bluetooth session is running: open this page and press X to stop
strings.ble_mac_save_failed: Error: could not save the Bluetooth MAC address.
strings.ble_keyboard_failed: Error: could not open or read the system keyboard.
strings.ble_patch_unknown: Error: cannot read the system version. Direct Bluetooth is unavailable.
strings.ble_patch_unsupported: Error: the Bluetooth patch supports HOS 22.5.0 only.
strings.ble_patch_missing: Error: Bluetooth patch missing. Install the matching patch and reboot.
strings.ble_patch_unreadable: Error: cannot read the Bluetooth patch. Check installation and reboot.
strings.ble_patch_invalid: Error: Bluetooth patch contents do not match. Install the matching patch and reboot.
strings.ble_patch_file_only: Bluetooth patch file verified; reboot after installation to apply it.
